RFID General Note
fields.options:
RFID Attendance — Overview

Enable RFID to allow student swipe data from physical card readers (installed at classroom gates and terminals) to flow automatically into SLCM.

Swipe Mode:
  In Only — records the first swipe of the day as entry. Suitable for classrooms where exit is not tracked.
  In and Out — records both entry and exit swipes. Used when gates track both directions.

Once enabled, go to RFID Card Management to assign cards to students, view unassigned swipes, and perform bulk imports.

RFID Poller Note
fields.options:
How the Automatic Poller Works

▶ Automatic sync: SLCM pulls new swipes from the SQL Server every 5 minutes via a background scheduler. No manual action is needed once configured.
▶ Watermark: The Last Processed SQL ID above tracks the last imported row. The poller only fetches rows with Id > last_processed_id — old data is never re-imported.
▶ Deduplication: Each SQL Server row has a unique Id. Even if a row is encountered twice, the poller skips it — no duplicate Attendance Logs are ever created.
▶ Batch size: Up to 500 rows are imported per run. If there is a large backlog, multiple runs will process it in sequence.
▶ Card assignment: Go to Attendance → RFID Card Management to link cards to students, view unassigned swipes, and run bulk imports.

⚠ To re-import all records from scratch: set Last Processed SQL ID to 0 and save. The next poll will reimport everything from the beginning. Use with caution on a live system.
